purpose: The one code base a new GilbPlatform app starts from: it loads the app's style, signs a person in and out, opens their own vault for the app (making it at the first sign-in), draws the frame for a wide window and a phone, and lets them share that vault.
namedChanges: New code, written on 2026-11-21. No product code was copied: every part is a call into app-shell, signin, lws-session-bridge, style-runtime, vault-share-sheet or vault-switcher. scripts/check-host-agnostic.mjs and src/hostAgnostic.test.ts are the repo's frame, copied from vault-share-sheet.
